ValidationRule.description: SS-8401 : Lock Ability to Change Opportunity Partner "Partner Account" field (post Fulcrum project)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Account__c) , OR( ISPICKVAL( Partner_Role__c , "Referral"), ISPICKVAL( Partner_Role__c , "Partner Creator"), ISPICKVAL( Partner_Role__c , "Partner Co-Sell") ), NOT($Profile.Name = "Tanium Partner Portal Admin"), NOT($User.Department = "Sales Operations"), NOT($Profile.Name = "Tanium System Administrator"), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have the required permissions to update the “Partner Account” when Partner Role = "Partner Co-Sell", "Partner Creator", or "Referral". Please reach out to ChannelOps@tanium.com to request a change.
